caption: The video captures a white ceramic cup decorated with a floral decal of maroon and yellow blossoms, green leaves, and red berry sprigs, resting on a slatted wooden table with its handle to the right. A thin gold band circles its base, while the blurred background—a curtained window, an orange object, and a dark wooden post—remains largely unchanged. The cup appears stationary, its position relative to the table slats and post consistent through the view. The main visible motion is a faint wisp of white steam rising above the rim, sometimes leaning to one side and sometimes to the other. This plume shifts and reshapes continuously, while no beverage or heat source is visible, so the emission reads as an ongoing process rather than a newly begun or completed action.
relations: The white ceramic cup remains stationary on the slatted wooden table, keeping its handle oriented to the right.
The blurred background, including the window and wooden post, stays largely unchanged throughout the view.
A faint wisp of white steam rises continuously from the cup's rim.
The steam plume shifts and reshapes, leaning alternately to one side and then the other as it ascends.
